recommendation: Keep the no-change audit. Treat FHIR-49963 and FHIR-50710 as the controlling current-build decisions unless BR&R opens a new issue to lower the THO research-study-phase binding strength.
issue_request: FHIR-14288 was Published/Persuasive for STU3 and requested changing the ResearchStudyPhase binding from Preferred to Example because the then-bound clinicaltrials.gov value set was considered US-realm terminology.
initial_application: No direct FHIR-14288-tagged implementation commit was found, but ResearchStudy.phase was Example before later R6 ResearchStudy work. The current build-scoped source now has ResearchStudy.phase at Preferred strength to http://terminology.hl7.org/ValueSet/research-study-phase.
additional_context: FHIR-49963 is a later Applied/Persuasive BR&R R6 issue that explicitly requested ResearchStudy.phase binding strength be Preferred and was approved 8-0-0 in BR&R minutes. Its implementation commit changed ResearchStudy.phase from Example to Preferred. FHIR-50710 later moved the binding URL to the THO research-study-phase ValueSet while preserving the Preferred strength, and that related THO cleanup is already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. Reverting the current source to Example for FHIR-14288 would conflict with the later FHIR-49963 decision and the current THO migration context.
